global_caption: The video contains 8 shots and is a short narrative film in warm-toned pixel art style depicting a fantasy treasure hunt. Nighttime public facilities are rendered in clear-grained, slightly flickering pixel imagery, dominated by amber gold and orange-red hues, with minimal deep blue night tones for spatial contrast. Lighting primarily consists of warm indoor illumination from museums and stations, along with glowing backlighting from runes and mechanical devices. Camera movement evolves from slow, stealthy pushes to high-speed tracking, culminating in an epic pull-back. The emotional tone remains balanced between mystery and excitement.
shot1: Shot 1 fades in from black, using medium close-up, low-angle eye-level framing. Display cases in the museum’s ancient hall form continuous leading lines in foreground and background. Warm exhibit lights slice bronze artifacts and stone carvings into pixelated highlights. A crimson gold dragon crouches before a case, nose nearly touching the treasure compass as it slowly sniffs. Its scales catch reflections from glass, outlining edges. Slightly blurred foreground objects frame its head as focus. The camera slowly pushes in and gently shifts right.
shot2: Shot 2 connects to previous shot via action-matched hard cut, now medium shot, oblique low-angle. Composition places a worn maintenance door in left foreground, right side showing half-lit ticket machine. The dragon follows the compass direction into the space behind the door, using its foreclaw to activate ancient runes on the machine surface. Runes surge from keypad up to screen, casting warm golden light on its claw tip and jaw. Internal gears begin turning. A glimpse of subway station lighting appears at the tunnel end. The camera first quickly pans to follow the claw motion, then abruptly pushes into the doorway. Piano motif rises, turnstile gears and fan roar intensify suddenly.
shot3: Shot 3 connects to previous shot via hard cut matched by dark interior area, switching to long shot, eye-level slightly low angle, showing an empty platform. Platform edge, ceiling light strips, and tracks create strong depth. Warm yellow lighting mixed with cool blue tunnel air. The vast space makes the dragon appear especially agile. It bursts from the maintenance passage, stopping on the left side of frame, looking toward the tunnel. Distant headlights rapidly approach. As the unmanned train glides into the platform, its pixelated body reflection flashes across dragon scales. At the moment the train passes, the dragon leaps onto the front carriage. The camera horizontally follows along the platform, then slightly tilts to trace the jump trajectory. Engine
shot4: Shot 4 connects to previous shot via hard cut matched by train movement direction, using wide shot, eye-level. After the train doors open, the platform connects directly to a dormant amusement park zone. Center frame shows a stationary carousel. Foreground holds remnants of ticket barriers; background reveals silhouettes of sleeping attractions in darkness. Warm overhead lights and remaining carousel bulbs serve as primary sources. The dragon leaps from the train door, gliding past the carousel edge. Wingtip and tail sweep hidden mechanisms. Carousel light strips ignite in concentric circles, pixel bulbs waking one by one. The camera performs a circular pan, following the dragon’s path around the outer rim, reanimating the static structures. Mood shifts from exploration to decisive progression.
shot5: Shot 5 connects to previous shot via soft transition via light glow, using near-medium to medium shot, slight upward tilt from overhead perspective. Composition initially focuses on the treasure compass at bottom of frame. Then a golden beam—activated jointly by runes and carousel mechanism—shoots straight down the bridge toward the distant stadium. Bridge railings form clear vanishing lines. Warm amusement park lights blur into pixel dots in background. The dragon lifts its head, following the beam to lock onto target. Body shifts from crouch to coiled readiness. The camera slowly rises from the compass and advances slightly forward. Wind grows stronger. Short piano phrases build suspense. Distant stadium emits low rumble of large fans and HVAC systems.
shot6: Shot 6 connects to previous shot via hard cut matched by beam direction, shifting to extreme long shot, low-angle tracking. The dragon flaps wings above the stadium stands. Entire seating area under warm lighting appears as dense pixel block array. Bridge exit and curved stand lines direct gaze toward central field. Wingbeats stir dust particles and flutter flags. Crimson gold scales flash grid-like in backlight. Camera starts from behind, then slightly overtakes to look back at dragon soaring over stands. Wind shear and massive ventilation system resonance sync with each wingbeat. Visual momentum continuously builds.
shot7: Shot 7 connects to previous shot via hard cut matched by dive action, using overhead extreme wide shot rapidly descending to medium shot. Central field becomes compositional focus. Hidden mechanical floor beneath grass awakens due to dragon’s impact and compass beam. Circular floor opens like an iris, metal plates sliding outward to reveal inner treasure chest. Foreground shows dragon’s folded wing shoulders. Background stand light strips illuminate progressively. Warm light remains dominant. Golden backlight erupts from ground fissures. Camera plunges downward from height, pausing briefly above the chest. Piano adds heavier bass arpeggios.
shot8: Shot 8 connects to previous shot via soft transition via glowing light spilling from chest interior. Starts with close-up, eye-level slightly low angle, capturing the crystal core inside the chest. Then within same shot, continuously pulls back and elevates to extreme long shot. Dragon lowers head, emitting a controlled stream of dragon fire—not explosive but steadily enveloping the lock ring. Surface patterns on the core unlock sequentially, radiating brilliant gold-red light. Then the entire stadium’s light strips, stands, and roof structure awaken in succession. In the distant skyline, the museum also lights up simultaneously, echoing the beginning. Foreground keeps chest and dragon head in sharp focus, then depth gradually expands to include bridge, amusement park station, and distant museum. Camera dramatically pulls back and ascends, finally freezing on two illuminated public facilities in the night cityscape. Piano concludes on final chord. Precise audiovisual synchronization occurs at the instant dragon fire emits, core unlocks, and entire venue lights up—leaving a mysterious yet grand finale.
